name: Enshrined
source:
Cyrano Val D'allaire, physician & occult scholar, takes a detour to the remote town of Squall's Peak to pay respects to an old friend. 

[From [url=https://dhxmpyr.itch.io/enshrined]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
医生兼神秘学研究者西拉诺·瓦尔·达莱尔，绕道前往偏远的飑峰镇，悼念一位老朋友。

[摘自[url=https://dhxmpyr.itch.io/enshrined]itch.io[/url]]
